attchmntText: Dhampur Bio Organics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  M/s. Jitender Navneet & Co., Cost Accountants as Cost Auditor of the company w.e.f. November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: Dhampur Bio Organics Limited has appointed Jitender Navneet and Co., Cost Accountants, as its Cost Auditor for the Financial Year 2026-27. The Board of Directors approved this appointment on November 14, 2026, based on the Audit Committee's recommendation. This action fills a casual vacancy caused by the demise of the previous Cost Auditor, Mr. S.R. Kapur. The firm, holding Firm Registration Number 000119, is registered with the Institute of Cost Accountants of India. The appointment is effective from November 14, 2026. The company filed this intimation with the BSE and NSE pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Dhampur Bio Organics Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the audited financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026 and approved the buyback subject to the approval of shareholders.
voiceSummary: Dhampur Bio Organics Limited approved audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved a buyback of equity shares with a face value of ten rupees each, for an aggregate amount not exceeding fifty crore rupees, subject to shareholder approval. A notice of postal ballot was approved to obtain this approval via remote e-voting. The company also appointed a Cost Auditor for the financial year 2026-27 to fill a casual vacancy. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Dhampur Bio Organics Limited has Intimated about the grant of stock options pursuant to DBO Employee Stock Option Scheme 2025 as approved by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee.
voiceSummary: Dhampur Bio Organics Limited announced that its Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved a grant of 1,66,000 stock options under the DBO Employee Stock Option Scheme 2025 on November 12, 2026. The options cover 1,66,000 equity shares with a face value of Rs. 10 each. The exercise price is set at Rs. 72 per equity share. Vesting begins after a minimum period of one year from the grant date. Twenty-five percent of the options will vest annually over four years, subject to performance criteria. Eligible employees may exercise the options within five years from the vesting date. The scheme complies with SEBI Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity Regulations, 2021. No options have been vested or exercised at this stage.

attchmntText: Dhampur Bio Organics Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Dhampur Bio Organics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of  Mr Harmeet Singh as Vice President - Financial Planning and Analysis of the company w.e.f. October 31, 2026.
Dhampur Bio Organics Limited has updated the information provided to the Exchange regarding Demise of  Mr. Surendra Rai Kapur, Cost Auditor of the Company.
